pr_comments:
Reproduction steps:
1. Open a channel which is not supported by NewPipe, e.g., https://www.youtube.com/channel/UClYV6hHlupm_S_ObS1W-DYw
2. Rotate the screen

Also test rotation on a normal channel, the behavior is the same as before.

Btw, I don't think I am able to test properly. The crash on this channel is actually fixed, but `showContentNotSupported` should do something: [making views visible and showing kaomojis](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/2e771cd65ab1eff2cb090351a4083d1d129fe53a/app/src/main/java/org/schabi/newpipe/fragments/list/channel/ChannelFragment.java#L573-L576). Could you look into why nothing of that happens? Btw, there is no need to do that in this PR.

### Checklist - [x] I am using the latest version - 0.21.15 - [x] I checked, but didn't find any duplicates (open OR closed) of this issue in the repo. - [x] I have read the contribution guidelines given at https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md. - [x] This issue contains only one bug. I will open one issue for every bug report I want to file. ### Steps to reproduce the bug 1. Open a channel which is not supported by NewPipe. 2. Rotate your device. 3. Observe app's behavior. ### Actual behavior The app crashes. ### Expected behavior The app displays the unsupported channel after device's rotation. ### Screenshots/Screen recordings https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/74829229/126073585-ca479278-202b-4429-b4a5-5d8fd932bd23.mp4 ### Logs ## Exception * __User Action:__ ui error * __Request:__ ACRA report * __Content Country:__ FR * __Content Language:__ fr-FR * __App Language:__ fr_FR * __Service:__ none * __Version:__ 0.21.6 * __OS:__ Linux Android 10 - 29

comments: I would like to work on this issue.

https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/629b685f5a4fc0ec137ee7fbcdff9fe9cd6c3ea5/app/src/main/java/org/schabi/newpipe/fragments/list/channel/ChannelFragment.java#L129-L133

The first line of code invokes `showContentNotSupported()`. But it relies on `channelBinding`, which might not be initialized.

The idea is to use an extra variable to mark whether ContentNotSupportedException occurs, and call `showContentNotSupported()` after the second line.

Is this fix all right?  
https://github.com/GGAutomaton/NewPipe/commit/2e771cd65ab1eff2cb090351a4083d1d129fe53a

I'm afraid I don't know if that's the good way to fix this, as I don't know specific things about Android development.

Anyway, you are now assigned :)

review_comments: Uhm, and what if `onViewCreated` has already been called when this point is reached? Then `showContentNotSupported();` will never be called.

I haven't encountered this situation before.

Another possible solution for this issue is to swap the order of these two lines. But idk if `handleResult()` will be called before `onViewCreated()`.
https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/173b6c3f00df02e64151ee642323205400d412f2/app/src/main/java/org/schabi/newpipe/fragments/list/channel/ChannelFragment.java#L130-L133
